revenue.source: FY2024/FY2025: ASML 2025 annual report financial performance section (28,262.9; 32,667.3). FY2023: ASML Q4 2023 release headline €27.6bn; 27,559 is from analyst recall, reviewer to verify (consistent with 32.8% op margin and EBIT 9,042).

operating_income.source: ASML Q4 2025 results release (6-K, Jan 28 2026) five-year table of income from operations, US GAAP, EUR m

d_and_a.source: ASML Q4 2024 US GAAP financial statements (FY2023 739.8, FY2024 918.6). FY2025 = sum of quarters 241.3+254.9+274.6+255.2 from later quarterly statements; reviewer to confirm vs 20-F. Includes amortization of debt costs and ROU depreciation.

capex.source: Purchase of property, plant and equipment: Q4 2024 statements (2023 2,155.6; 2024 2,067.2); 2025 annual report (1,573.6). Excludes intangibles (2024: 15.9; 2025: 57.6).

revenue_growth.source: FY2026: midpoint of ASML guidance €34-39bn (€36.5bn) vs 32.67bn = +11.7% (Q4 2025 release). Later years: assumption, fading growth toward long-run semis/EUV demand trend; backlog €38.8bn supports near term.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 34.6%, 3-yr range 31.9-34.6%; guided gross margin 51-53% in 2026; held at 34%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: ASML effective tax rate historically ~16-17% (Dutch innovation box); not verified in this session.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 PP&E capex 1,573.6 / revenue 32,667.3 = 4.8%; ASML is expanding capacity so kept at this level

wacc.source: Assumption: ~4% risk-free/ERP-based cost of equity ~8.5-9%, minimal debt, beta ~1.2; not sourced from a data provider

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal GDP / inflation, below WACC

net_debt.source: Debt: long-term debt 2,709.0 (Q4 2025 US GAAP balance sheet) + current portion ~1,710 (stockanalysis.com balance sheet, may include small lease/other items; verify vs 20-F) = 4,419; less cash and short-term investments 13,321.9 (ASML Q4 2025 release) = -8,902.9 (net cash).

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares FY2025 = 388.9m, ASML Q4 2025 US GAAP statements (6-K Jan 2026)
